caption: The drawing depicts a small, pouch-like bag with a soft, gathered upper half and a structured, woven lower half. The upper part of the bag is a light beige color and features two round, embroidered designs: the left design is pink and the right design is blue, both bordered with yellow-gold thread and surrounded by decorative loops and dot patterns. The lower section of the bag is composed of tightly woven brown and golden threads, giving it a textured, checkered appearance. There are two thin, yellow-gold drawstrings emerging from each side of the bag, allowing it to be cinched at the top. The bottom center of the bag features a long, multicolored tassel composed of light yellow and pink threads. The background is a plain off-white, and the artist’s signature “Dolores A. Haupt” appears in red at the lower right corner of the drawing.
title: Silk-straw Reticule
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
